questionOutcomes.result: x=l_perp/cos(theta) for a named perpendicular ray spacing; internal spacing uses theta=beta, exterior spacing uses theta_out. Source alpha/l alone do not define the requested x.

questionOutcomes.result: For a higher-index prism in a common exterior and direct two-face refraction, physical ray deviation is toward the base and apparent image displacement is toward the apex. Inverse index ordering reverses it; equal indices give none.
questionOutcomes.qualification: No source numerical index or displacement magnitude is assigned. An unqualified direction without index ordering is not established.

questionOutcomes.result: N_glass sin(theta)>N_water; only conditionally at theta=45 degrees, N_glass/N_water>sqrt(2). Equality is the grazing boundary.
questionOutcomes.genuineHOLD: Actual figure161/162 ray semantics remain HOLD, and no source numeric glass/water pair is supplied. No diagram-specific yes/no conclusion.
questionOutcomes.minimumAdditionalAuthority: Separate accepted actual-path evidence and adequate accepted index data, supplied as text to this exhausted image context.

questionOutcomes.result: A side-normal reflected path can see the newspaper if the long face supplies the stated 45-degree TIR and the lower boundary transmits. Long-face normal and oblique views are different: under common low-index exterior, normal short-face encounters can be TIR while an oblique direct long-face/bottom route still exists when m<1/sin(22.5 degrees).
questionOutcomes.genuineHOLD: The same prism does not specify whether water immersion continues, air replaces it, what the bottom contact/gap is, or which observation direction is intended.
questionOutcomes.minimumAdditionalAuthority: Accepted medium/contact/view-direction conditions. No blanket side/long-face yes/no answer or source figure PASS.

questionOutcomes.result: No propagating escape to air for the same ray at parallel water/oil/air interfaces: K=N_water sin(alpha)>N_air is conserved. Oil either has no propagating branch or passes the same forbidden K to the final air boundary.
questionOutcomes.boundary: K=N_air is the grazing limit, not nonzero normal escape and not strict supercritical TIR.
questionOutcomes.qualification: Homogeneous positive-index transparent media, fixed ray/frequency, flat parallel layers and no edges/scattering. Arbitrary poured-oil surface geometries are not determined.

questionOutcomes.result: Equal positive vertex distances give internal angles 30 degrees. For m=N_prism/N_exterior, sin(i)=sin(e)=m/2. Non-grazing crossing requires m<2; m=2 is the grazing boundary/supremum, not an attained non-grazing maximum.
questionOutcomes.absoluteForm: N_prism<2N_exterior; with unequal exteriors, N_prism<2 min(N_entry,N_exit).
questionOutcomes.genuineHOLD: An absolute numerical bound needs the exterior reference; treating the boundary as an included maximum needs an explicit grazing convention.
